metadata.title: Microsoft Purview / IRM gap-filler analytic rules for Microsoft Sentinel
metadata.description: Sentinel scheduled analytic rules targeting detection gaps NOT covered by native Purview DLP, IRM Adaptive Protection, MDA, Activity Explorer, or Sentinel UEBA/Fusion. v2.2 adds per-rule enable parameters and ingestion-cost guidance.
metadata.author: Agentic-SOC

metadata.description: Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace name (in the target resource group).
Min distinct files per user/IP per hour for the bulk-DLP rule.
Min total DLP rule hits per user/IP per hour for the bulk-DLP rule.
Alert when MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection has no rows for this many hours despite baseline activity in the prior 7 days.
Min distinct items per user per hour to trigger AR-PURVIEW-LABEL-MASS-MODIFICATION.
Min RMS access denials per user per hour to trigger AR-RMS-DECRYPTION-FAILURES.
Min reported export size (MB) to trigger AR-EDISCOVERY-EXPORT-ABUSE on a single export job.
Min anonymous / company-share link creations per user per hour to trigger AR-SPO-ANONLINK-BURST.
Min distinct newly-classified assets per data source per hour to trigger AR-DSPM-CLASSIFICATION-SPIKE.
Min total high-fidelity classification hits per data source per hour to trigger AR-DSPM-DATA-SPILL.
Regex applied to DataSourceName / AssetName / AssetPath for AR-DSPM-NONPROD-SENSITIVE. Match indicates non-production zone.
Regex applied to DataSourceType / DataSourceName / AssetPath for AR-DSPM-CROSS-CLOUD-SOVEREIGNTY. Match indicates non-Azure / non-approved cloud.
Regex matching ClassificationName values that carry sovereign / regional residency obligations.
Regex applied to AssetPath / AssetName / DataSourceName for AR-DSPM-UNAUTHORIZED-PATH.
Deploy the companion hunting queries (savedSearches, Category=Hunting Queries) alongside the analytic rules.

properties.displayName: Purview - Sensitivity label downgraded (tenant-wide gap-filler)
properties.description: Tenant-wide visibility into label downgrade events. Purview IRM 'Sensitivity label downgrade' indicator only fires for users in an IRM policy; this rule covers everyone else.
properties.query:
let lowConfidentialLabels = dynamic(["Public","General","Internal"]);
MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where LabelEventType in ("LabelDowngraded","SensitivityLabelChanged")
   or (isnotempty(OldSensitivityLabelId) and OldSensitivityLabelId != SensitivityLabelId)
| where LabelName in (lowConfidentialLabels) or isempty(LabelName)
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, DeviceName, ItemName,
          OldLabel=OldSensitivityLabelId, NewLabel=SensitivityLabelId,
          LabelName, JustificationText, Workload, Application
| extend AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP, FileName = ItemName

properties.displayName: Purview - Bulk DLP rule matches by single user (rule-burst gap-filler)
properties.description: Detects bursts of DLP rule matches by a single user/IP. Complements MDA 'Mass download' (file-count) and IRM 'Cumulative exfiltration' (risk-score) by counting DLP-rule firings - a denominator neither native control covers.
properties.query:
[concat('MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(PolicyName) and isnotempty(ExecutionRuleName)
| extend RuleSeverity = tostring(Severity)
| summarize Hits = count(),
            UniqueFiles = dcount(ItemName),
            Files = make_set(ItemName, 25),
            Policies = make_set(PolicyName, 10),
            Rules = make_set(ExecutionRuleName, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
        by UserId, ClientIP
| where UniqueFiles >= ', string(parameters('bulkDlpUniqueFilesThreshold')), ' or Hits >= ', string(parameters('bulkDlpHitsThreshold')), '
| extend AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP')]

properties.displayName: Purview - DLP override or business justification used (no native default alert)
properties.description: Override / justification events are logged in Purview Audit but do NOT raise a default alert. This rule turns them into Sentinel incidents.
properties.query:
MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(OverRideType) or isnotempty(OverRideReason)
   or array_length(OverriddenActions) > 0
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, ItemName,
          PolicyName, ExecutionRuleName, OverRideType, OverRideReason, JustificationText
| extend AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP, FileName = ItemName

properties.displayName: Purview - Sensitivity label removed (tenant-wide gap-filler)
properties.description: Detects label-removal events tenant-wide. IRM's equivalent indicator only covers users enrolled in an Insider Risk policy.
properties.query:
MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where LabelEventType == "LabelRemoved"
   or (isnotempty(OldSensitivityLabelId) and isempty(SensitivityLabelId))
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, DeviceName, ItemName,
          OldLabel=OldSensitivityLabelId, JustificationText, Workload
| extend AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP, FileName = ItemName

properties.displayName: Audit / eDiscovery tampering - audit disabled, mailbox bypass, purge actions
properties.description: Detects high-risk Exchange / Compliance Center operations that disable auditing or use eDiscovery purge actions. None of these raise a default Microsoft alert today.
properties.query:
let tamperOps = dynamic([
  "Set-AdminAuditLogConfig",
  "Set-Mailbox",
  "New-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation",
  "Remove-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation",
  "Remove-ComplianceSearch",
  "Remove-ComplianceSearchAction",
  "New-ComplianceSearchAction",
  "Set-ComplianceSearchAction",
  "Remove-CaseHoldPolicy",
  "Remove-CaseHoldRule"
]);
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Operation in (tamperOps)
| extend ParamsStr = tostring(Parameters)
| where (Operation == "Set-Mailbox" and ParamsStr has_any ("AuditEnabled\":\"False","AuditEnabled=False"))
     or (Operation == "Set-AdminAuditLogConfig" and ParamsStr has_any ("UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled\":\"False","AdminAuditLogEnabled\":\"False"))
     or (Operation == "New-ComplianceSearchAction" and ParamsStr has "Purge")
     or Operation in ("New-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation","Remove-MailboxAuditBypassAssociation","Remove-ComplianceSearch","Remove-ComplianceSearchAction","Set-ComplianceSearchAction","Remove-CaseHoldPolicy","Remove-CaseHoldRule")
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, UserAgent, Operation, ResultStatus, OfficeWorkload, OfficeObjectId, ParamsStr
| extend AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP

properties.displayName: Purview admin abuse / config drift - DLP or label policies disabled, non-eDiscovery role group changes
properties.description: Detects Purview Compliance admin operations that disable / delete DLP or label policies, or grant non-eDiscovery role-group membership. eDiscovery / Compliance Admin / Reviewer role grants are handled by the dedicated AR-EDISCOVERY-ROLE-ESCALATION rule.
properties.query:
let driftOps = dynamic([
  "Disable-DlpCompliancePolicy",
  "Remove-DlpCompliancePolicy",
  "New-DlpCompliancePolicy",
  "Set-DlpCompliancePolicy",
  "Remove-DlpComplianceRule",
  "Set-DlpComplianceRule",
  "Remove-LabelPolicy",
  "Set-LabelPolicy",
  "Disable-LabelPolicy",
  "Remove-Label",
  "Set-Label",
  "Add-RoleGroupMember",
  "Remove-RoleGroupMember",
  "New-RoleGroup",
  "Update-RoleGroupMember"
]);
let eDiscoveryRoleGroups = dynamic(["eDiscovery Manager","eDiscovery Administrator","Compliance Administrator","Compliance Data Administrator","Reviewer"]);
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Operation in (driftOps)
| extend ParamsStr = tostring(Parameters)
| where not(Operation in ("Add-RoleGroupMember","Remove-RoleGroupMember","New-RoleGroup","Update-RoleGroupMember") and ParamsStr has_any (eDiscoveryRoleGroups))
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, UserAgent, Operation, OfficeWorkload, OfficeObjectId, ResultStatus, ParamsStr
| extend AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP

properties.displayName: Purview - Ingestion stall on MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
properties.description: Fires when MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection has zero rows for the configured stall window despite a baseline of activity in the prior 7 days. Catches connector / audit-pipeline outages that would silently kill detections.

properties.displayName: Purview - Mass sensitivity-label modification by single user
properties.description: Detects scripted / automated stripping or rewriting of sensitivity labels: one user changing labels on many distinct items in a 1h window. Distinct from DLP rule-burst (counts label CHANGES, not DLP firings). IRM 'Cumulative exfiltration' uses risk score, not label-change count, so this is a real gap.
properties.query:
[concat('let unique = ', string(parameters('labelMassModUniqueItems')), ';
MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where LabelEventType in ("LabelChanged","LabelDowngraded","LabelRemoved","LabelUpgraded","SensitivityLabelChanged","SensitivityLabelRemoved")
   or (isnotempty(OldSensitivityLabelId) and OldSensitivityLabelId != SensitivityLabelId)
| summarize ItemCount = dcount(ItemName),
            Items = make_set(ItemName, 25),
            Workloads = make_set(Workload, 5),
            EventTypes = make_set(LabelEventType, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
        by UserId, ClientIP
| where ItemCount >= unique
| extend AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP')]

properties.displayName: Purview - Persistent RMS / AIP decryption failures by single identity
properties.description: Repeated Rights Management Service decryption / access denials by one identity, indicating systematic probing of protected files. Not a default Microsoft alert; IRM only reacts when a user is in scope of an IRM policy.
properties.query:
[concat('let denials = ', string(parameters('rmsDenialThreshold')), ';
MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Operation has_any ("AccessDenied","DecryptionFailed","RightsManagementServiceFailure","RmsAccessDenied","AipAccessDenied","Decryption")
| summarize Denials = count(),
            Items = make_set(ItemName, 25),
            Devices = make_set(DeviceName, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
        by UserId, ClientIP
| where Denials >= denials
| extend AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP')]

properties.displayName: eDiscovery - Search export abuse (large export or non-admin actor)
properties.description: Detects eDiscovery / Compliance search exports that are unusually large, OR initiated by a user who is not in eDiscovery role groups. Catches data exfiltration via the Compliance portal export path. Microsoft does not raise a default alert on export size.
properties.query:
let exportOps = dynamic(["SearchExportDownloaded","SearchExportCompleted","PurviewSearchExportJobCreated","GetActionsForAllExports","New-ComplianceSearchAction"]);
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where RecordType in ("24","DiscoveryEvents","AeD","Discovery") or Operation in (exportOps)
| extend ParamsStr = tostring(Parameters)
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, UserAgent, Operation, RecordType, OfficeObjectId, ParamsStr
| extend AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP

properties.displayName: eDiscovery - Privilege escalation via role group membership
properties.description: Detects additions to eDiscovery Manager / eDiscovery Administrator / Compliance Administrator / Reviewer role groups in Microsoft 365. Default Microsoft alerts only cover global Entra role assignments, not the Purview-side compliance role groups.
properties.query:
let eDiscoveryRoleGroups = dynamic(["eDiscovery Manager","eDiscovery Administrator","Compliance Administrator","Compliance Data Administrator","Reviewer"]);
let officeRoleEvents =
    OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where Operation in ("Add-RoleGroupMember","New-RoleGroup","Update-RoleGroupMember","Set-RoleGroup")
    | extend ParamsStr = tostring(Parameters)
    | where ParamsStr has_any (eDiscoveryRoleGroups)
    | extend Source = "OfficeActivity", AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP, Detail = ParamsStr;
let entraRoleEvents =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where OperationName in ("Add member to role","Add eligible member to role","Add member to group")
    | extend Targets = tostring(TargetResources)
    | where Targets has_any (eDiscoveryRoleGroups)
    | extend Source = "AuditLogs",
             AccountUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
             IPAddress = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
             Detail = Targets;
officeRoleEvents
| project TimeGenerated, Source, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Operation = coalesce(Operation, ""), Detail
| union (entraRoleEvents | project TimeGenerated, Source, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Operation = OperationName, Detail)

properties.displayName: Purview DLP match from unfamiliar location or unmanaged device
properties.description: Joins Purview DLP / label events with SigninLogs to flag the same UserId hitting DLP from a country never seen for that user in 30d, OR from a device that fails Conditional Access compliance / is unmanaged. Native MDA impossible-travel does not key on label / DLP context.
properties.query:
let lookback = 14d;
let userCountries =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(lookback) .. ago(1h))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | summarize KnownCountries = make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), 25) by UserPrincipalName;
let recentSignins =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2h)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion),
             DeviceCompliant = tobool(DeviceDetail.isCompliant),
             DeviceManaged = tobool(DeviceDetail.isManaged),
             ConditionalAccessFailed = (ConditionalAccessStatus == "failure")
    | project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Country, IPAddress, DeviceCompliant, DeviceManaged, ConditionalAccessFailed;
MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where isnotempty(PolicyName) or isnotempty(SensitivityLabelId)
| join kind=inner (recentSignins) on $left.UserId == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, SigninTime)) <= 60
| join kind=leftouter (userCountries) on $left.UserId == $right.UserPrincipalName
| extend NewCountry = iff(isempty(KnownCountries) or not(set_has_element(KnownCountries, Country)), true, false)
| extend RiskFlag = case(
    NewCountry, "NewCountry",
    DeviceManaged == false, "UnmanagedDevice",
    DeviceCompliant == false, "NonCompliantDevice",
    ConditionalAccessFailed, "CAFailure",
    "")
| where RiskFlag != ""
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, IPAddress, Country, RiskFlag, ItemName, PolicyName, ExecutionRuleName
| extend AccountUpn = UserId

properties.displayName: Azure diagnostic settings deleted or disabled (Sentinel / Purview / Defender scope)
properties.description: Detects deletion / write of Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings on resources that feed Sentinel - Log Analytics workspaces, Key Vaults, Storage accounts, Front Door, App Gateway, Defender. Catches the 'silence the SIEM' move that Set-AdminAuditLogConfig does NOT cover.
properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where OperationNameValue has "Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings"
   or OperationNameValue has "microsoft.aadiam/diagnosticSettings"
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success","Succeeded","Started")
| where OperationNameValue endswith "/delete" or OperationNameValue endswith "/write"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, ResourceGroup, _ResourceId, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Properties
| extend AccountUpn = Caller, IPAddress = CallerIpAddress, ResourceId = _ResourceId

properties.displayName: SharePoint / OneDrive - Anonymous-link burst by single user (SPO365-Scanner pattern)
properties.description: Detects bursts of anonymous / company-share / external-share link creations across many sites by one identity, the action signature of automated SP/OneDrive scanners (SPO365-Scanner, ROADtools-style enumeration). Purview 'Overshared content' reports the static state, not bursty creation.
properties.query:
[concat('let burst = ', string(parameters('anonLinkBurstThreshold')), ';
let shareOps = dynamic(["AnonymousLinkCreated","AnonymousLinkUpdated","CompanyLinkCreated","AddedToSecureLink","SecureLinkCreated","SharingPolicyChanged","SharingSet","SharingInvitationCreated","AddedToGroup"]);
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where OfficeWorkload in ("SharePoint","OneDrive","OneDriveForBusiness")
| where Operation in (shareOps)
| extend Site = coalesce(Site_Url, OfficeObjectId)
| summarize Shares = count(),
            UniqueSites = dcount(Site),
            Sites = make_set(Site, 25),
            UniqueTargets = dcount(TargetUserOrGroupName),
            Targets = make_set(TargetUserOrGroupName, 25),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
        by UserId, ClientIP
| where Shares >= burst or UniqueSites >= max_of(5, burst/3)
| extend AccountUpn = UserId, IPAddress = ClientIP')]

properties.displayName: Purview DSPM - Unlabelled sensitive data discovered (PurviewDataSensitivityLogs)
properties.description: Purview DSPM scan found classified sensitive content (SITs, trainable classifiers) in assets that have NO sensitivity label applied. Native DSPM dashboards show this as posture; this rule turns it into actionable alerts when at least 5 unlabelled assets surface in a 4h window per data source.
properties.query:
PurviewDataSensitivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
| where array_length(Classification) > 0
| where array_length(SensitivityLabel) == 0
| summarize Hits = count(),
            UniqueAssets = dcount(AssetName),
            Assets = make_set(AssetName, 25),
            Classifications = make_set(Classification, 25),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
        by PurviewAccountName, SourceName, SourceType
| where UniqueAssets >= 5
| extend HostName = SourceName

properties.displayName: Purview DSPM - Classification spike on a single data source (PurviewDataSensitivityLogs)
properties.description: Sudden surge of newly-classified assets on a single data source can indicate mass-import of sensitive data, ransomware staging, or shadow-IT promotion. Native DSPM dashboards trend volume but do not alert. Threshold tunable via dspmSpikeUniqueAssets.
properties.query:
[concat('let spike = ', string(parameters('dspmSpikeUniqueAssets')), ';
PurviewDataSensitivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where array_length(Classification) > 0
| summarize NewClassifications = count(),
            UniqueAssets = dcount(AssetName),
            Assets = make_set(AssetName, 25),
            Classifications = make_set(Classification, 25),
            Labels = make_set(SensitivityLabel, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
        by PurviewAccountName, SourceName, SourceType
| where UniqueAssets >= spike
| extend HostName = SourceName')]

properties.displayName: Purview DSPM - High-fidelity sensitive data in non-production / test zone (PurviewDataSensitivityLogs)
properties.description: Production data copied to dev / test / sandbox / QA / staging assets is a recurring PCI-DSS, HIPAA and GDPR finding. Triggers when SSN, credit card, bank account, passport, driver license, tax-ID or similar high-fidelity classifications appear in an asset whose name / path matches the non-prod regex.
properties.query:
[concat('let highFidelity = dynamic(["Social Security","Credit Card","Bank Account","Passport","Driver","Tax Identif","Tax File","National ID","National Identif","Insurance Number","IBAN","Medical","CPF","DNI","CNI","Fiscal Code"]);
let nonProdPattern = "', parameters('dspmNonProdNamePattern'), '";
PurviewDataSensitivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
| where array_length(Classification) > 0
| where Classification has_any (highFidelity)
| where (SourceName matches regex nonProdPattern) or (AssetName matches regex nonProdPattern) or (AssetPath matches regex nonProdPattern)
| summarize Hits = count(), UniqueAssets = dcount(AssetName), Assets = make_set(AssetName, 25), Classifications = make_set(Classification, 25), Labels = make_set(SensitivityLabel, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by PurviewAccountName, SourceName, SourceType
| extend HostName = SourceName')]

properties.displayName: Purview DSPM - Cross-cloud / sovereign-region data residency violation (PurviewDataSensitivityLogs)
properties.description: Sovereign-classified data (EU NID, GDPR PII, country-specific tax / passport / driver IDs) discovered in a data source whose type or location matches a non-approved cloud (AWS / S3, GCP / BigQuery, on-prem, external) or region. Catches AWS S3 buckets holding EU citizen data and similar residency breaches.
properties.query:
[concat('let sovereign = "', parameters('dspmSovereignClassificationPattern'), '";
let disapproved = "', parameters('dspmDisapprovedDataSourceTypes'), '";
PurviewDataSensitivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
| where array_length(Classification) > 0
| where tostring(Classification) matches regex sovereign
| where (SourceType matches regex disapproved) or (SourceName matches regex disapproved) or (AssetPath matches regex disapproved)
| summarize Hits = count(), UniqueAssets = dcount(AssetName), Assets = make_set(AssetName, 25), Classifications = make_set(Classification, 25), Labels = make_set(SensitivityLabel, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by PurviewAccountName, SourceName, SourceType
| extend HostName = SourceName')]

properties.displayName: Purview DSPM - High-fidelity sensitive data in unauthorized storage path (PurviewDataSensitivityLogs)
properties.description: High-fidelity classifications (SSN, credit card, bank account, passport, driver, tax IDs, IBAN, medical) discovered in paths matching common unsanctioned patterns (anonymous / public / temp / shared / external / quarantine / backup / dump / export / scratch). Complements the non-prod rule with path-based, not name-based, matching.
properties.query:
[concat('let highFidelity = dynamic(["Social Security","Credit Card","Bank Account","Passport","Driver","Tax Identif","Tax File","National ID","National Identif","Insurance Number","IBAN","Medical","CPF","DNI","CNI","Fiscal Code"]);
let badPath = "', parameters('dspmUnauthorizedPathPattern'), '";
PurviewDataSensitivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
| where array_length(Classification) > 0
| where Classification has_any (highFidelity)
| where (AssetPath matches regex badPath) or (AssetName matches regex badPath) or (SourceName matches regex badPath)
| summarize Hits = count(), UniqueAssets = dcount(AssetName), Assets = make_set(AssetName, 25), Classifications = make_set(Classification, 25), Labels = make_set(SensitivityLabel, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by PurviewAccountName, SourceName, SourceType
| extend HostName = SourceName')]

properties.displayName: Purview DSPM - Sensitive data spill volume threshold (PurviewDataSensitivityLogs)
properties.description: Burst of high-fidelity classifications on a single data source within an hour. A single sensitive file is operational cleanup; hundreds appearing at once points to a rogue data dump or a broken automated process exporting production databases to unprotected shares. Threshold tunable via dspmSpillThreshold.
properties.query:
[concat('let spill = ', string(parameters('dspmSpillThreshold')), ';
let highFidelity = dynamic(["Social Security","Credit Card","Bank Account","Passport","Driver","Tax Identif","Tax File","National ID","National Identif","Insurance Number","IBAN","Medical","CPF","DNI","CNI","Fiscal Code"]);
PurviewDataSensitivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where array_length(Classification) > 0
| where Classification has_any (highFidelity)
| summarize TotalHits = count(), UniqueAssets = dcount(AssetName), Assets = make_set(AssetName, 25), Classifications = make_set(Classification, 25), Labels = make_set(SensitivityLabel, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by PurviewAccountName, SourceName, SourceType
| where TotalHits >= spill
| extend HostName = SourceName')]

properties.query:
let lowConfidentialLabels = dynamic(["Public","General","Internal"]);
MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where LabelEventType in ("LabelDowngraded","SensitivityLabelChanged")
   or (isnotempty(OldSensitivityLabelId) and OldSensitivityLabelId != SensitivityLabelId)

properties.displayName: HQ - DLP match from unfamiliar location / unmanaged device (24h)
properties.query:
let lookback = 14d;
let userCountries = SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated between (ago(lookback) .. ago(24h)) | where ResultType == 0 | summarize KnownCountries = make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), 25) by UserPrincipalName;
let recentSignins = SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(25h) | where ResultType == 0 | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), DeviceCompliant = tobool(DeviceDetail.isCompliant), DeviceManaged = tobool(DeviceDetail.isManaged), ConditionalAccessFailed = (ConditionalAccessStatus == "failure") | project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Country, IPAddress, DeviceCompliant, DeviceManaged, ConditionalAccessFailed;
MicrosoftPurviewInformationProtection
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where isnotempty(PolicyName) or isnotempty(SensitivityLabelId)
| join kind=inner (recentSignins) on $left.UserId == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, SigninTime)) <= 60
| join kind=leftouter (userCountries) on $left.UserId == $right.UserPrincipalName
| extend NewCountry = iff(isempty(KnownCountries) or not(set_has_element(KnownCountries, Country)), true, false)
| extend RiskFlag = case(NewCountry, "NewCountry", DeviceManaged == false, "UnmanagedDevice", DeviceCompliant == false, "NonCompliantDevice", ConditionalAccessFailed, "CAFailure", "")
| where RiskFlag != ""
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, IPAddress, Country, RiskFlag, ItemName, PolicyName, ExecutionRuleName

tags.name: description
tags.value: DLP hits correlated with unfamiliar country, unmanaged device, or CA failure.
